newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Palm sees no prices problem from weak mark.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Palm sees no prices problem from weak mark.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Guntram Palm said on Tuesday that the Bundesbank did not see current foreign exchange levels as posing an inflationary danger for Germany.
"The current currency rate levels pose no dangers for price stability," he told Reuters in an interview. "Momentarily inflation is not plaguing us."
He also said that he saw no reason for the Bundesbank to change interest rates for the time being.

"There are no factors that would prompt the Bundesbank to veer from its steady hand policy," he said, adding that the Bundesbank's credibility and steadfastness in such issues was one of its biggest assets.
"With us, you know where you're at," he said.
